extracted.name: Blueberry Swim Biscuits
extracted.description: Great recipe for Blueberry Swim Biscuits.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 Cup Melted Butter Melted & Cooled to Room Temp
instruction_lines: Sift flour into a mixing bowl
Add in Baking Powder, Salt & Sugar
Create a well in the middle of the bowl & gradually add buttermilk
Stir until combined WITHOUT over mixing
Add in blueberries gently folding into dough
Pour melted room temp butter into baking pan
Add dough directly on top of melted butter & gently spread out
Use a knife to cut the dough into 9 pieces
For Glaze: combine powdered sugar, milk & vanilla extract
Remove from oven & let cool for 5 minutes then drizzle glaze
